crown.name: Vertex (Crown / Top of Head)
crown.definition: Highest anatomical surface point on cranium along superior axis.

plantar_left.name: Left Plantar Sole Landmark
plantar_left.definition: Inferior plantar boundary of left heel/foot.

plantar_right.name: Right Plantar Sole Landmark
plantar_right.definition: Inferior plantar boundary of right heel/foot.

suprasternale.name: Suprasternale (Jugular Sternal Notch)
suprasternale.definition: Midline palpable notch on superior border of manubrium sterni.

substernale.name: Substernale (Xiphisternal Joint)
substernale.definition: Inferior margin of corpus sterni at junction with xiphoid process.

perineum.name: Perineum (Pelvic Floor / Crotch Floor)
perineum.definition: Lowest central pelvic surface point between the thighs at crotch junction.

acromion_left.name: Left Acromiale
acromion_left.definition: Most lateral and superior palpable point on the acromial process of the left scapula.

acromion_right.name: Right Acromiale
acromion_right.definition: Most lateral and superior palpable point on the acromial process of the right scapula.

radiale_left.name: Left Radiale (Lateral Elbow)
radiale_left.definition: Most proximal and lateral margin of the head of the radius / lateral epicondyle.

radiale_right.name: Right Radiale (Lateral Elbow)
radiale_right.definition: Most proximal and lateral margin of the head of the radius / lateral epicondyle.

stylion_left.name: Left Stylion (Radial Styloid)
stylion_left.definition: Most distal palpable point on the styloid process of the left radius.

stylion_right.name: Right Stylion (Radial Styloid)
stylion_right.definition: Most distal palpable point on the styloid process of the right radius.

trochanterion_left.name: Left Trochanterion (Greater Trochanter)
trochanterion_left.definition: Most superior lateral point on the greater trochanter of the left femur.

trochanterion_right.name: Right Trochanterion (Greater Trochanter)
trochanterion_right.definition: Most superior lateral point on the greater trochanter of the right femur.

tibiale_left.name: Left Tibiale Laterale (Lateral Knee)
tibiale_left.definition: Most lateral point on the upper margin of the lateral condyle of the left tibia.

tibiale_right.name: Right Tibiale Laterale (Lateral Knee)
tibiale_right.definition: Most lateral point on the upper margin of the lateral condyle of the right tibia.

sphyrion_left.name: Left Sphyrion Fibulare (Lateral Malleolus)
sphyrion_left.definition: Most distal point on the lateral malleolus of the left fibula.

sphyrion_right.name: Right Sphyrion Fibulare (Lateral Malleolus)
sphyrion_right.definition: Most distal point on the lateral malleolus of the right fibula.
